C-64.IntentSummary: Rebuild the Mark site in the ¶ paper/ink/marker brand: shared tokens + fonts + no-flash theme, a custom VitePress theme, a mobile-first landing in the user-chosen hero direction with an iPhone "Mark for Mac" bar, consent that never covers the hero, download_click, the SEO/llms/security set and a meta CSP by hashes; checks + screenshot matrix; deploy through site.yml after the user's OK.

Corner.Situation: iPhone 390, first visit from the EU
Corner.Expected: "Mark for Mac" bar on first paint, hero headline + App Store action in the first screen, no consent card until the hero is scrolled past

Corner.Situation: iPhone, Web Share unavailable or cancelled
Corner.Expected: "Copy link" copies the canonical URL and confirms in place; share_to_mac fires with result copied/dismissed only after consent
native App Store banner from apple-itunes-app; no custom bar

Corner.Situation: Saved theme "dark", OS light, open a docs page then the landing then /diagrams/
Corner.Expected: dark on first paint on all three, no flash; toggling anywhere carries over

Corner.Situation: 320 px and 844×390 landscape on every page
Corner.Expected: scrollWidth ≤ innerWidth; nav fits; nothing under the notch (safe-area)

Corner.Situation: An inline script edited without rebuilding the CSP
Corner.Expected: check-dist fails: hash of every inline script must appear in the page's CSP meta
no GA request, no download_click; links still work
landing readable, install links and brew command visible, version text is the current release (not a stale fallback)

T-001.Title: Brand foundation: site/shared tokens (light/dark) + type scale, fonts consolidated under site/public/fonts (Bricolage 800, Plex Sans 400/500/600, Plex Mono 500; Schibsted/JetBrains removed), no-flash head script shared by landing/docs/gallery (VitePress storage key), custom VitePress theme site/.vitepress/theme (extends DefaultTheme: tokens, fonts, nav/header/footer, code, tables, containers, Editions catch-up cards), gallery migrated to the shared tokens; stale facts in site/index.md and site/guide/*.md fixed

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: R-1, R-2, R-10, D-8 for docs; gallery + editions tests green; nav fits 390 with no overflow.

Verification.Command: cd site && npx vitepress build . && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
npx vitest run tests/site tests/renderer/editions-doc.test.js tests/renderer/site

T-002.Title: Landing rebuild per D-9 (design/d3.html hero, d1 fact strip, d2 wall as ¶ 02): mobile-first sections (¶ numbered), install block (App Store / Homebrew copy / Windows), iPhone/iPad "Mark for Mac" bar (Web Share → copy fallback, remembered dismiss), download_click + share_to_mac events through a consent-aware helper, verified copy, no-JS fallbacks

Verification.Command: cd site && npx vitepress build . && node scripts/check-dist.mjs

T-003.Title: Head, consent, security: landing.mjs shared head (JSON-LD SoftwareApplication, apple-itunes-app, theme-color from tokens, referrer, hreflang x-default), OG card script + committed PNG, llms.txt, .well-known/security.txt, consent.js placement/timing (after hero, slim card), CSP meta with sha256 hashes computed in buildEnd (site/scripts/csp.mjs) for landing and gallery (docs: hashed or documented exception)

T-004.Title: Checks + evidence: check-dist extensions (R-11), tests/site for csp/jsonld/head helpers, Playwright matrix tests/e2e/site-matrix.spec.ts (320/390/1440/844×390 × light/dark × /, /guide/, /guide/editions, /diagrams/: overflow, consent vs hero, iPhone bar), Lighthouse run, GRACE M-053 graph + V-M-053 verification

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All verification commands green; grace lint 0; screenshots shown to the user.

T-005.Title: Deploy (orchestrator, after the user's OK): commit on main, git push fork main, watch the site workflow, verify prod with curl (head tags, llms.txt, security.txt, CSP) and the Playwright matrix against https://mark.xronocode.com

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: site workflow green; prod passes the matrix.

C-64.Execution: T-001 by one ZCode agent; T-002 and T-003 by two ZCode agents in parallel worktrees (disjoint files: T-002 owns site/landing/index.html, T-003 owns landing.mjs/consent.js/public/scripts); T-004 split between a ZCode agent (tests, matrix spec) and the orchestrator (runs, review, GRACE close-out); T-005 orchestrator only.
